verdict.rationale: PostHog documents personal API keys with individually invalidatable, per-scope grants (e.g. insight:read) plus org-level scope auditing, an OAuth flow for third-party apps to get scoped access without sharing keys, a live OAuth-gated MCP server exposing 150 granular scopes (action:read/write, cohort:read/write, etc., confirmed by probe), and CLI/MCP tool-level scoping via URL params or presets for agent workflows. This directly matches issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report specifically validating scope enforcement in practice beyond vendor docs and probes.
